description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Vi''' empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals '''modified''' physical damage to enemies hit in a cone.

''Relentless Force'' can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for (100% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|30%]]) AD '''bonus''' physical damage against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.
description.text:
Active: Vi empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  50 bonus range and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals modified physical damage to enemies hit in a cone.
Relentless Force can critically strike for (100% +  30%) AD bonus physical damage against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.

description2.raw: '''Vi''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Relentless Force'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
description2.text: Vi periodically stocks a Relentless Force charge, up to a maximum of 2.

description3.raw: ''Relentless Force [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Vi's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Relentless Force resets Vi's basic attack timer.

leveling.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
10 / 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 (+ 110% AD) (+ 100% AP)

notes.raw: * Applies [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]] to the primary target, applies [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] required effects on the primary target, and applies [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]] to secondary targets. * The empowered attack has the same windup time as '''Vi's''' basic attacks. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block damage to secondary targets, but not to the primary target. * ''Relentless Force'' will only apply a stack of [[File:Vi Denting Blows.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Denting Blows|An icon for Vi's ability Denting Blows]] [[Vi#Denting Blows|Denting Blows]] to the primary target. * If the ''Relentless Force'' buff is about to run out as '''Vi''' starts the attack windup, the duration will be updated and extended to allow '''Vi''' to still sucessfully attack.
notes.text:
Applies spell damage to the primary target, applies basic damage required effects on the primary target, and applies area damage to secondary targets.
The empowered attack has the same windup time as Vi's basic attacks.
Spell shield will block damage to secondary targets, but not to the primary target.
Relentless Force will only apply a stack of Denting Blows to the primary target.
If the Relentless Force buff is about to run out as Vi starts the attack windup, the duration will be updated and extended to allow Vi to still sucessfully attack.
